attention_head_stability.logit_comparison_gauge: content and positional-bias logits are centered within each receiver/head before signatures and contribution diagnostics

embedding_stability.method: linear CKA and optional orthogonal Procrustes

execution.runtime_scope_note: report records extraction and CPU analysis through report finalization; publication verification runtime is returned by the command and is not retroactively inserted into the immutable bundle

fixed_probe_edge_stability.score_scope: per-edge permutation-invariant mean-head scores on locked receivers

attention_mean_head.support_definition: membership in that seed's top 5% mean-head attention values over the locked fixed-probe edge set

receiver_centered_combined_logit_mean_he.support_definition: absolute score strictly greater than zero

receiver_centered_content_logit_mean_hea.support_definition: absolute score strictly greater than zero

receiver_centered_positional_bias_mean_h.support_definition: absolute score strictly greater than zero

limitations: Four model seeds quantify ensemble spread, not a calibrated confidence interval.
All diagnostics are held-in and transductive; they do not estimate generalization.
Attention is computational routing and is not direct signaling or causality.
Gradients are local, scale-dependent model sensitivities and are not causality.
Head alignment is derived from fixed held-in probes and may not be unique.
The axial orientation representation cannot distinguish opposite polarity.
The 24 selected gradient probes are sparse and are not representative of all edges or genes.
Any finite nonzero gradient, however small, counts as support under the locked protocol.
Models stopped at different plateau epochs, so exposure duration can contribute to observed seed spread.

mutual_attention_routing_stability.selection: union of each seed's top 100 pairs within each core

claim_scope.statement: These derivatives are selected local, scale-dependent model sensitivities under a fixed held-in fit mask. They do not establish correlation, direct signaling, a biological mechanism, patient replication, or causality.

attention_derivative.analysis_scope: selected relationships only; no exhaustive Jacobian

prediction_derivative.analysis_scope: selected relationships only; no exhaustive Jacobian

selected_gradient_stability.prediction_derivative_unit: standardized-log1p target prediction units per standardized-log1p source expression unit
selected_gradient_stability.probe_scope: 24 sparse prespecified requests, not representative of all edges or genes
selected_gradient_stability.support_definition: absolute gradient strictly greater than zero
